description: Pull SEC filings and company financials into a workflow, straight from EDGAR: a company's profile and filing history, the numbers it reports in XBRL, and the text of any filing since 1993. Look a company up by ticker rather than by its ten-digit SEC id, read the figures behind an annual report, compare one line item across every company that reported it, or search the full text of every filing since 2001 for a phrase. Watch the live feed for 8-Ks as they are filed, walk the daily and quarterly indexes, and read or download any filing document. Free and public: no account, no API key, and nothing to pay for.
